people.name: Ain
people.line: A city in Judah, allotted to the Levites.

people.name: Beth-shemesh
people.line: City in Judah, associated with the Ark's return.

people.name: Juttah
people.line: A town in the hill country of Judah, a Levitical city

translations.web: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.
translations.bsb: Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh—nine cities from these two tribes, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
translations.asv: and Ain with its suburbs, and Juttah with its suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with its suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
